sloka: मयि जीवितमायत्तं राघवस्य महात्मनः ।भ्रातऽणां च महाबाहो तव राजकुलस्य च ।। ५.३७.५८।।।।।
transliteration: mayi jīvitamāyattaṁ rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ ।bhrāta'ṇāṁ ca mahābāho tava rājakulasya ca ।। 5.37.58।।।।।

translations.english: "All your effort for my sake would be futile. Hence Rama's arrival along with you will be of great benefit.
